_meta.role: 864zeros central content/data store — source-of-truth JSON assets, published to consuming apps.
principles: JSON is the source of truth; any database under db/ is a derived, rebuildable, git-ignored artifact.
Namespace = ownership boundary: shared/ = ecosystem-generic assets; apps/<name>/ = that app's published content.
sources/ = raw public-domain inputs kept for provenance (not served); _build/ = extractor scripts, style guides, drafts.
All content is public-domain-derived, original 864zeros authorship. IP posture documented per namespace.

layout.shared/: ecosystem-generic assets any app may consume
layout.sources/: raw source texts (PD PDFs / EPUB / docx) — provenance, not served
layout._build/: extractor/build scripts, style guides, per-chapter drafts (reproducibility)
layout.db/: generated SQLite, rebuilt from JSON via _build/build_db.ps1 (git-ignored)

shared/bible.title: Public-domain Bible key-verse library
shared/bible.summary: 66 books. Record: { book, chapter, citation, text, plain } — text = verbatim PD scripture, plain = original 864zeros 2026 rendering. KJV (NT + most OT), WEB rendered 'the Lord' (Psalms & Proverbs). No review gates.

apps/clearstreak.title: ClearStreak recovery content (1939 Big Book, PD-derived)
apps/clearstreak.gate: passages_core.json carries needs_clinical_review:true — no ship without an LCSW/CADC pass; final PD legal read still owed before store build.
